 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 07, 2026 
 Link copied 
 RED WINGS (7-7-3) at AVALANCHE (9-6-2) 
 9 p.m. ET; DSN, ALT 
 Red Wings projected lineup 
 Alex DeBrincat -- Emmitt Finnie -- Viktor Arvidsson
 Michael Brandsegg-Nygard -- Andrew Copp -- Lucas Raymond
 Michael Rasmussen -- J.T. Compher -- John Leonard
 Carter Mazur -- Sheldon Dries -- Keegan Kolesar
 Ben Chiarot -- Moritz Seider
 William Wallinder -- Justin Faulk
 Andreas Englund -- Anton Johansson
 Daniil Tarasov
 Michal Postava
 Scratched: Nate Danielson 
 Injured: Mason Appleton (undisclosed), Marco Kasper (upper body), Albert Johansson (undisclosed), John Gibson (lower body) 
 Suspended: Dylan Larkin 
 Avalanche projected lineup 
 Artturi Lehkonen -- Nathan MacKinnon -- Martin Necas
 Gabriel Landeskog -- Nazem Kadri -- Nicolas Roy
 Jaden Schwartz -- Brock Nelson -- T.J. Hughes
 Parker Kelly -- Fedor Svechkov -- Logan O’Connor
 Brett Kulak -- Cale Makar
 Devon Toews -- Sam Malinski
 Noah Juulsen -- Brent Burns
 Mackenzie Blackwood
 Scott Wedgewood
 Scratched: None 
 Injured: Zachary L’Heureux (upper body), Josh Manson (lower body) 
 Status report 
 Danielson, a forward, was on the ice with Detroit’s injured players after the morning skate and is not expected to play. … Leonard is expected to return after being scratched for a 2-1 loss to the Vegas Golden Knights on Thursday. … Colorado is expected to dress the same lineup from a 3-2 overtime loss to the Nashville Predators on Thursday.
